description: Curated Super-Grassmannian ownership / comparison registry. Every declaration reference is validated against the current Lean source by tools/infra/supergrassmannian_ledger.py. A comparison claim may only exist as a named Lean declaration. Classification protocol: docs/COLIMIT_LEDGER_PROTOCOL.md.

status_vocabulary.canonical_owner: designated owner for a mathematical lane; other files in the lane are consumers
status_vocabulary.closure: proves the remaining algebra/representation laws for an existing owner carrier
status_vocabulary.application: uses an owner's carriers/theorems for a physical or geometric readout; may locally redeclare structures
status_vocabulary.invariants_only: proves parity/sign invariants on a combinatorial model; no bundle or geometric space constructed
status_vocabulary.dimension_arithmetic: dimension/shift arithmetic only; explicitly not a constructed colimit (per file header)
status_vocabulary.algebraic_carrier: defines an algebraic carrier (structures/laws); no manifold or topology asserted
status_vocabulary.representation_bridge: explicit map between two lanes with proved compatibility
status_vocabulary.transport: carries data/actions/forms across an existing map or involution
status_vocabulary.partial_comparison: limited comparison proved under explicit hypotheses; no general identification of the compared notions asserted

entries.title: Scalar 1|1 supermatrix foundation
entries.scope: scalar 1|1 carrier: parity, Koszul signs, block operations
entries.notes: Scalar model retained per audit SS5.1; the general p|q owner is `sg.general-supercarrier`. The general-to-scalar specialization is proved in `sg.general-scalar-closure`.

entries.title: General block supercarrier owner
entries.scope: general block supertrace, deformation modes, chiral-square laws
entries.notes: Designated owner for the block supertrace (audit SS3/SS5.2). The nuclear and graph-Dirac lanes redeclare `superTrace`; specialization theorems are the open obligation (gap `supertrace-specialization`).

entries.title: General-to-scalar supertrace bridge
entries.scope: multiplication-preserving representation Fin 1 (+) Fin 1
entries.notes: Explicit representation of the scalar carrier into one-point block matrices; proves the general supertrace specializes to the scalar supertrace and transports the chiral-square law. Discharges the scalar direction requested in audit SS5.2.

entries.title: Generic chiral projector closure
entries.category: real vector space with involutive grading
entries.scope: LinearChiralGrading: projector idempotence and orthogonality
entries.notes: Closes the projector pair laws for the generic `LinearChiralGrading` carrier from `sg.module-colimit-sato` (audit SS3 overlap of projector definitions).

entries.title: Fock direct-limit action closure
entries.scope: associativity of the descended Fock action
entries.notes: The descended Fock action is associative with the direct-limit Clifford multiplication on the actual colimit carriers. Complements `native_splitClifford_fock_grade_action_compatible` (grade equivariance) registered under `sg.module-colimit-sato`.

entries.title: Grade additivity closure (FiveGraded x KantorTanaka)
entries.scope: adH grade-one assignment and grade-additive contact bracket
entries.notes: Bridges the FiveGraded Cartan action `adH` to the KantorTanaka odd contact bracket. Note: this is the ordinary commutator bracket; the graded-bracket convention comparison remains a gap.

entries.title: Para-projector / sheet geometry owner
entries.category: involutive operator on a real inner-product space
entries.scope: complementary projectors, primal/vacuum sheets, isotropy
entries.notes: Owner for the para-Kaehler sheet/projector realization. The range identifications relate projector formulas to explicit sheet predicates; no manifold structure is asserted here.

entries.title: Five-graded matrix model (Kantor-Tanaka nucleus)
entries.category: 3x3 matrix units over a comm ring
entries.scope: H = diag(1,0,-1), adjoint action, quintic identity, grade roots
entries.notes: Finite nucleus of the five-grading; D^5 - 5D^3 + 4D = 0 for D = adH. Grade facts are transported to the contact bracket in `sg.grade-closure`.

entries.title: Kantor-Tanaka contact bracket owner
entries.scope: bracket, Jacobi, spinor bilinears, grade truncation, J-involution
entries.notes: Explicit bracket architecture with ordinary matrix commutator; the Jacobi identity and derivation law are proved. Compare `sg.osp-jordan-pair` for the graded-bracket convention; no general comparison theorem exists yet (gap `graded-bracket-comparison`).

entries.title: OSp graded brackets and Jordan pair
entries.scope: graded superBracket, commutation/anticommutation, Jordan pair
entries.notes: Carries the graded (super) bracket convention and Jordan-pair interfaces; the general comparison to the KantorTanaka ordinary bracket remains open (audit SS2/SS5.4).

entries.title: Majorana CAR superalgebra owner
entries.scope: a, a*, Gamma, number operator, ladder brackets
entries.notes: Finite CAR/parity carrier feeding the Sato/Fock lanes; concrete matrix model in `sg.split-clifford-matrix-witness`.

entries.title: Sato/Fock cyclic readout owner
entries.scope: projectors, number operator, normalized cyclic traces
entries.notes: Stage-local readouts (trace/index) used by the Sato and Grothendieck bridges. Header notes matrix-stage limit readouts; the restricted Fredholm Sato geometry is outside this owner (gap `restricted-sato-fredholm`).

entries.title: Graded bonding compatibility owner (Sato colimit lane)
entries.category: graded inductive sequences and module action systems
entries.scope: grade/action intertwining chains; concrete split-Clifford/Fock compat
entries.notes: Home of the chain-level compatibility theorems answering the audit's target: grade intertwining (Gamma_{n+k} iota = iota Gamma_n), action intertwining, projector intertwining, and the concrete split-Clifford/Fock grade-action compatibility on the true colimit carriers.

entries.title: Split-Clifford dimension arithmetic
entries.scope: vector/spinor/chiral-half dimensions and equal-shift arithmetic
entries.notes: Header explicitly states the results are dimension formulas and equal-shift arithmetic, NOT a constructed inductive colimit (audit SS3). Must not be cited as a colimit construction.

entries.title: Berezinian/Stiefel-Whitney parity invariants
entries.scope: parity signs, orientability criterion, first SW invariant model
entries.notes: Implements parity/sign invariants on a combinatorial cocycle model; no Berezinian line bundle, sheaf cohomology, or geometric Stiefel-Whitney class is constructed (audit SS4).

entries.title: Nuclear quasiphonon application carrier
entries.scope: SUSY generators, supertrace cancellation, Berezinian homothety
entries.notes: Redeclares its own `superTrace` and mode structure; candidate to become a specialization of `sg.general-supercarrier` (audit SS3).

entries.title: Graph-Dirac supercarrier application
entries.scope: Hodge-Dirac chirality, Berezinian invariants, mode supertraces
entries.notes: Second redeclared `superTrace`; shares scale/chiral/volume mode structure with the general owner. Specialization bridge is the open obligation (audit SS3).

entries.title: Algebraic para-Kaehler carrier ('manifold' name)
entries.scope: pseudo-Riemannian metric, para-complex structure, projector/orthocomplement
entries.notes: Despite the file name, this is an algebraic para-Kaehler carrier with projector/orthocomplement laws; no charts, atlases, smooth or supermanifold structure (audit SS4; gap `supermanifold-structure`).

entries.title: Moebius reflection / polarization owner
entries.scope: Mobius involution, polarization anticommutation, metric isometry
entries.notes: Algebraic reflection model underlying the crosscap/CPT lanes.

entries.title: Unoriented CPT/Krein form transport
entries.scope: P/C/T/K operators, sheet swap, Krein/symplectic form invariance
entries.notes: Transport layer for forms and involutions; asserts operator identities on an explicit doubled carrier, not spacetime symmetry.

entries.title: Real Majorana chiral ideal (SUSY supercharge)
entries.scope: PL/PR projectors, Peirce decomposition, Q/Qdag nilpotency, SUSY H
entries.notes: Finite real model of the chiral ideal with SUSY algebra relations; companion audit file registers non-vacuity witnesses.

entries.title: Grothendieck/Sato motive bridge
entries.scope: motive decomposition, virtual index = gamma, trace descent to limit
entries.notes: Stage-to-limit Grothendieck transport with a commutator-vanishing trace descent; connects the Fock readouts to K0-style classes (algebraic level).

entries.title: Sato/GNS pre-Hilbert subfactor bridge
entries.category: pre-Hilbert inner product on stage matrices
entries.scope: GNS inner product, dimension ratio, noncommutativity at the limit
entries.notes: Pre-Hilbert (algebraic) GNS readout on matrix stages; no completion or topological subfactor structure asserted (see colimit ledger's completion lanes for the analytic side).

entries.title: Split-Clifford matrix witness
entries.scope: concrete matrix model of the split-Clifford cell and Majorana CAR
entries.notes: Explicit 2x2 real realization witnessing non-vacuity of the split-Clifford/Majorana relations (audit SS5.6-type concrete bridge).

entries.title: Contact bracket vs parity-aware superbracket (partial)
entries.scope: shared SupergradedBracket owner; contact-generator specialization
entries.notes: Compares the ordinary Kantor-Tanaka contact bracket to the shared parity-aware `superBracket` only where the reverse product vanishes (hypothesis discharged by matrix computation for both contact generators). Explicitly does NOT identify the two bracket conventions for arbitrary odd pairs. Partially closes `graded-bracket-comparison`.

comparisons.notes: The general block supertrace specializes to the scalar model via an explicit multiplication-preserving matrix representation.
On the true algebraic colimit carriers (SplitCliffordInfinity, FockInfinity): grade equivariance plus action associativity with the direct-limit multiplication.
Chain-level form of the audit's target: Gamma_{n+k} iota_{n,n+k} = iota_{n,n+k} Gamma_n, action intertwining, and projector intertwining under linear bonding.
The named sheets equal the ranges of the explicit projectors; relates the formula presentation to the predicate presentation.
Form (anti-)invariance and sheet exchange under the CPT/charge operators on the doubled carrier.
FiveGraded adH acting on the KantorTanaka contact bracket: grade-one assignment, grade additivity, derivation law.
Explicit matrix witness for the CAR relations; shows the carrier is non-degenerate.
Stage-to-limit multiplicative transport with vanishing trace on commutators (algebraic trace descent).
Two concrete contact-generator comparisons; the reverse-product vanishing hypotheses are discharged by matrix computation.

gaps.description: Four independent `superTrace`-family definitions exist (GeneralSupercarrierDeformation, NuclearQuasiphononSuperGrassmannian, GraphDiracSupercarrierEmbedding, KantorTanakaSuperGrassmannian). The general owner is designated; the scalar direction is discharged by `sg.general-scalar-closure`. Remaining: specialization theorems for the nuclear, graph-Dirac, and Kantor-Tanaka variants.
gaps.suggested_next: Prove carrier maps from the nuclear/graph/Kantor-Tanaka models into the general block carrier and derive their supertrace theorems from `GeneralSupercarrierDeformation.superTrace`.

gaps.description: KantorTanaka's `bracket` is the ordinary matrix commutator; SuperconformalOSpJordanPair develops `superBracket` with explicit even/odd cases. `GradedBracketComparison` now proves the two concrete contact-generator comparisons under a vanishing reverse-product hypothesis, plus the general criterion `commutator_eq_superBracket_odd_odd_of_reverse_mul_eq_zero`; this is the exact scope where the conventions provably agree. The general identification for arbitrary odd pairs remains open and is explicitly disclaimed by the file.
gaps.suggested_next: Extend the comparison to further odd pairs only with discharged hypotheses; keep the general-pair identification as a separate theorem if it ever holds.

gaps.description: Chain-level action intertwining and the concrete split-Clifford/Fock grade-action compatibility are proved. Remaining: a uniform descent statement for the generic `GradedModuleActionSystem`, i.e. a bundled linear action on the colimit carrier commuting with the colimit injections, with uniqueness.
gaps.suggested_next: Mirror the colimit ledger's `descendDirectLimit_unique` pattern: define the descended action on the filtered colimit of the GradedModuleActionSystem diagram and prove its stage laws and uniqueness.

gaps.description: Projectors occur in three presentations: para-model (SuperGrassmannianProjectorBridge), Fock `projPlus`/`projMinus` (SatoColimitTriality), and the generic `LinearChiralGrading` closure (ChiralProjectorClosure). No proved map relates the Fock projectors to the para model through the actual involutions (audit SS3: do not identify because formulas look alike).
gaps.suggested_next: Define the involution-commuting map from the Fock carrier to the para carrier and prove projector compatibility.

gaps.description: BerezinianSheafStiefelWhitney proves parity/sign invariants on a Cech-cocycle model. A Berezinian line bundle, sheaf cohomology, and a geometric Stiefel-Whitney class are NOT constructed (audit SS4).
gaps.suggested_next: Define the Berezinian transition data as an actual line bundle over the base and prove the parity class equals the first SW class of a constructed bundle.

gaps.description: SuperGrassmannianManifold provides an algebraic para-Kaehler carrier with projector laws; there are no charts, atlases, smooth structure, or supermanifold/superscheme structure (audit SS4).
gaps.suggested_next: Separate the algebraic carrier from a genuine supermanifold construction; if pursued, define local models and gluing data with explicit transition functions.

gaps.description: The Sato/GNS lanes are algebraic/pre-Hilbert (stage chains, GNS pairing). The restricted-subspace (Fredholm) Sato Grassmannian with its topology is explicitly outside the current owners (audit SS4).
gaps.suggested_next: If the restricted Sato geometry is pursued, add the Fredholm condition and topology layer as a new owner rather than extending the algebraic chains in place.

guardrails: A comparison/equivalence claim requires a named Lean declaration in the registered owner file; semantic or formula similarity must not create comparison edges (e.g. the three projector presentations).
Redeclared structures (e.g. `superTrace` in the nuclear and graph-Dirac files) are not unified until a specialization theorem exists; the bridge is registered only when it lands.
Dimension/equal-shift arithmetic (`SplitCliffordSuperGrassmannianColimit`) must not be cited as a constructed inductive colimit.
Parity/sign invariants (`BerezinianSheafStiefelWhitney`) must not be cited as a Berezinian bundle, sheaf cohomology, or geometric Stiefel-Whitney class.
The algebraic para-Kaehler carrier (file named 'Manifold') does not assert a manifold or supermanifold; keep the algebraic and geometric scopes separate.
This ledger is navigation evidence only; Lean owner source and kernel-checked declarations (via the locked build or Pantograph) decide truth.
